historicalObservation.limitation: Partial historical observation, not a complete profiler trace or a matched post-capture-fix trial.

requirements: Use matching host, model, effort, HISEW, signing and protected-target policy for baseline and candidate; retain bundle hashes and all failed trials.
Run one arm at a time using the existing approved host and evaluation setup. Exact input/model authorization precedes each external launch.
Authorize the named disposable hosted repository, exact refs and allowed effects before configuring or publishing; the local fixture does not establish branch protection.
Reuse the fixture's actual prior check only while its subject and applicability remain valid; it is task evidence, not a helper receipt.

Freeze exact scope, reviewed context, destination, message format and authority in each trial prompt. Source authority excludes PR creation/merge; main authority explicitly includes the selected permitted route.
The agent consumes only the installed skill, relevant references, public help and returned next actions; graders inspect final Git/provider state independently.
Collect native evidence before annotating observations. Unknown telemetry stays null. Do not infer model or hook time from residual wall time.
Report helper duration sums and occupied intervals separately; exclude hosted waiting from agent latency comparisons without hiding total time.
The local helper budget excludes publication preflight/refresh, publication and native PR operations. Budget overruns never authorize skipping controls.
Report all four matched outcomes and retain the historical observation separately. Calibrate any seconds budget from authorized repeated measurements.
